title: What If Every Spider on Earth Vanished?

scenes.text: What if every spider vanished tomorrow? The biggest change would be what they stop eating.
Together, spiders weigh about twenty-five million tons, and they kill four hundred to eight hundred million tons of prey every year.
For comparison, humans eat around four hundred million tons of meat and fish a year. Spiders eat at least that much.
More than ninety percent of their prey is insects and springtails, so those animals would lose a huge natural predator.
Spiders reach up to a thousand individuals per square meter, and they hunt most in forests and grasslands.
Take them away and insects would face far fewer hunters. The planet's biggest pest control would simply stop.

description:
What if every spider on Earth vanished?
A 2017 study estimates spiders eat 400 to 800 million tons of prey a year, mostly insects.
